job.job_description:
About the Role

As part of our operational transformation, we are enhancing AI-related skill alignment within our engineering team. We are looking for a dynamic SRE / DevOps Engineer who has strong adaptability and hands-on experience in SRE BAU Operations, CI/CD, DevOps, Monitoring, and AI-driven automation. This role will play a key part in strengthening platform reliability while leveraging modern AI tools such as CursorAI, Generative AI models, and automation frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Handle SRE BAU (Business-As-Usual) operations including incident management, problem resolution, root-cause analysis, and service restoration.
Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation across environments.
Drive operational excellence through DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, and system optimization.
Implement and monitor observability tools (logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards).
Utilize AI tools (CursorAI, Generative AI, automation copilots) to accelerate troubleshooting, documentation, code generation, and incident analysis.
Improve platform reliability, scalability, and performance through automation and proactive monitoring.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and security teams to ensure smooth releases and secure infrastructure.
Contribute to reducing manual operational work through AI-assisted solutions and scripting.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Skills

Strong hands-on experience with SRE or DevOps operations
Expertise in CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.)
Experience in monitoring & observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, ELK, Datadog, New Relic, etc.)
Good understanding of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)

AI & Automation

Practical usage of AI tools in daily engineering workflows (CursorAI, ChatGPT, GenAI, automation assistants)
Ability to identify repetitive tasks and automate them using AI or scripting
Familiarity with AI-driven troubleshooting and documentation tools

Scripting & Automation

Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, Ansible (preferred but not mandatory)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in supporting production environments with on-call rotations
Understanding of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of system performance tuning and capacity planning
Experience integrating AI into operational workflows or automation pipelines

What We Expect

Strong adaptability and willingness to learn new tools quickly
Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity and reduce effort
Ownership mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and continuous improvement attitude
Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills
